successor_panel.source_exclusion: All exact canonical candidate records from the pinned dynamic inventory; training/evaluation exact-record overlap must be zero.
successor_panel.selection_rule: Ongoing after eight plies, with the same owner holding an R in hand and an R on board plus a promoted P-base/R-current piece. No outcomes or search values.

cost_bound_seconds.basis: Use the existing source-bound no-repeat-scan projection at both 1800s training and evaluation caps, retain its 1200s variance reserve, and add a separate 180s cap for preparation plus a separate 180s audit allowance. Prior measured rule15 preparation was 15.853s; the new source inventory is larger, so it receives its own conservative cap.

limits: The 5317.12s bound is a planning projection, not a completion guarantee; the added caps leave further margin below the hard limit.
Exact-record exclusion does not establish descendant-state, transposition, or distributional independence.
One generated 4x4 rules15 candidate does not establish full Generic-domain coverage.
The prior task2626 roots and outcomes remain exposed and are not reused for training or evaluation.
